answers.core: I believe this feature would significantly simplify the animation tree usability for complex animation state machines, which is, in my opinion, an essential aspect of any 3D game engine.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around using sub-state machines, but it's not convenient because accessing the sub-state machines states requires more coding, since it requires you to access the sub-state machine before traveling to a specific state inside it, so while it makes the animation tree itself more organized, it also makes coding the transitions slightly more cumbersome and not as straight-forward.

title: Add reroute/branching nodes to animation tree editor.
